name: media-video-production
description: Runs a multi-shot video job end to end, as a piece or a shot-planned keyframe film: script or screenplay with a per-shot timing contract, a plan gate, stills (a film: masters, a keyframe per shot, a frame gate), one clip per shot with one move, a drift check and clip fence, voiceover per shot, music, duck and loudness, titles last, watch-and-listen, delivery with stems. Quotes each paid stage first; each approval is a gate file. Use when: make a video, short film, story, explainer, promo, tour, trailer or narrated piece from a brief, script or stills; put voiceover and music under generated clips; assemble, mix or burn titles over a multi-shot cut; resume a project stopped at a gate. NOT for: one clip (media-video-generation); only a voiceover, bed or transcript (media-audio-generation); a script alone (media-script-writer); shot wording (media-shot-craft); overlays alone (media-motion-graphics); stills (media-image-generation); running ai-gen (media-ai-gen); measuring files (media-qc).
